Class Seidel

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.util.tri.TriangulationMethod
com.j3d.engine.scene.nodes.util.tri.Seidel
public final class Seidel extends TriangulationMethod
Seidel's polygon triangulation method.

Decomposes simple planar polygons into y-monotone sub-polygons by identifying cusps (split and merge reflex vertices) via horizontal trapezoidal queries, inserting internal diagonals, and triangulating each y-monotone sub-polygon in linear time.
